observations.RE-1: Bruker TDF: the last MS1 frame that msconvert writes is absent from the conversion (14 of 15 spectra).
observations.RE-2: Waters MSMS/MRM: activation written as CID (MS:1000133) and no collision energy, where msconvert writes beam-type CID (MS:1000422) with the energy of the function.
observations.RE-3: Bruker PASEF/MRM: no dissociation-method term in <activation>, where msconvert writes CID (MS:1000133).
observations.RE-4: Thermo FT scans that store profile and vendor centroids: --peaks file writes the centroids, msconvert without filters writes the profile (a choice to state, not a decoding error).
